messages.subject: crowdfunding for lavaan
parts:
Dear lavaan user,

The user base of lavaan is expanding rapidly, and lavaan has become
'critical software' in several research domains. At the same time, the
`bus factor' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bus_factor) for the lavaan
project currently stands at just one, with the primary developer (Yves
Rosseel) facing mounting challenges in allocating sufficient time to
maintain, let alone advance, the lavaan package.

This situation is inherently unsustainable, prompting us to actively
seek solutions for bolstering the lavaan project. In light of this, we
humbly request your consideration of contributing to the project through
a donation. The funds raised will be earmarked exclusively for the
recruitment of highly qualified staff, at the post-doctoral level, to
provide essential support and elevate the professionalism of the lavaan
project. Your generous support will help ensure the continued growth and
vitality of the lavaan software.

More information is provided on the lavaan donation page:

https://lavaan.ugent.be/about/donate.html

If you are already convinced, and you wish to donate right away, click
on the following link:

https://actieplatform.ugent.be/en-GB/p/lavaan-project/step-1

Please spread the word, and distribute this message in your network.

Yves Rosseel.

messages.subject: Re: crowdfunding for lavaan
parts:
Yves,

 

I am applying for a big grant at the end of the year and will do the budget today. I do not think that I can budget a donation, though. The donations website says: “Please be aware that most funding agencies do not permit the use of project funds for donations. Nevertheless, you have the option to make a voluntary payment for ‘lavaan support,’ and we can provide you with an official invoice upon request.” This is a good option, but it would be a lot easier if there was a website that listed prices for such “lavaan support” service. Otherwise, I will need to justify why I pay 1000e per year instead of e.g. 900e per year. The project that I am applying for runs for 4 years and I could budget a donation for every year. It is administratively a lot easier to get approval for a four-year support contract instead of having to get the expense approved every year.

 

I will make a personal donation after I have figured out how the tax deductions for donations work.

 

Mikko

messages.subject: Re: crowdfunding for lavaan
parts:
Hello Mikko,

Thanks for the feedback. I understand what you are saying, but it is not
trivial to 'list' prices. The background is this: I cannot open a 'shop'
on a UGent hosted website. In fact, it is incredibly difficult to
'receive' money at the university side (in a legal way). Donations are
one way, but they are often not an option for 'professional money'.
Paying for 'lavaan support' is more like a service (similar to paying me
for giving a lavaan workshop). But although I may spend some of
professional time providing 'services', that should be limited. So it is
gray zone...

We are actively looking for a solution. But it is really, really
difficult. The most likely option (for the moment) is that I need to set
up a company, which could provide a webshop. Using this website, you
would be able to 'buy' lavaan support, and other lavaan related
services. Then, once enough money has been gathered, the company can
then 'donate' the money to the university by setting up a 'chair' which
can be used by the lavaan project. An enormous hassle indeed.

Yves.
